workClass: project requirements recovery preview and plan gate; surfaces A, B, C, and D apply
scoreJustification: The review independently re-parsed all named artifacts, recomputed every stated count, checked every manifest hash, enumerated all FR AC and mappings, compared every forward operation to its inverse, queried live MCP counts, and inspected the exact server transaction code. One point is reserved because semantic correctness against executable VICE behavior is not runnable from this artifact-only gate. The unresolved semantic evidence is treated as failure, not assumed correct.

failFindings.claim: Atomicity is not the only blocker.
evidence: Four update operations replace nonempty TR bodies with empty strings: TR-ROMM-SEC-001, TR-VIC20-FLASH-001, TR-VIC20-PIXEL-001, and TR-VIC20-SOUND-001.
Five placeholder TR bodies exist; only the three cross-type TEST ids are deleted. [TR-REMOTECTRL-SERVER-001] and PERF-SPRITE-DMA-OPT-001 remain preserved placeholders.
Four updates reduce acceptance-criteria counts, and the invariant list reports only MCP-REQUIREMENTS-ATOMICITY. Therefore the explicit only-blocker claim is false.

failFindings.claim: Nonempty and long FR criteria do not establish that all 232 FR AC sets are validation-appropriate.
evidence: New-InferredAcceptanceCriteria at tools/New-RequirementsRecoveryLedger.ps1:413-441 copies declarative body sentences and appends a generic mapped-TEST sentence; it performs no behavior-versus-mechanism classification or VICE execution check.

ARCH-TRUEDRIVE-1541-002 criteria specify IecBus.Tick(), IecDrive.Tick(), and IecDrive.ReadSector(), which are implementation mechanisms. FR-DRVMODEL-001 criteria specify enum, protocol, factory, and persistence mechanisms.
All 24 inferred AC sets explicitly require owner review. Treating them as satisfying the invariant before that approval overstates readiness.

failFindings.claim: The preview does not complete behavior/architecture/test classification or canonical typed-identity repair.
evidence: Independent canonical-pattern scan found 13 noncanonical or wrong-prefix typed records, including FR-kind ARCH-TRUEDRIVE-1541-002, BACKFILL-MEDIA-001, BACKFILL-VIDEO-001, and RUNTIME-TAPE-002; TR-kind [TR-REMOTECTRL-SERVER-001], PERF-SPRITE-DMA-OPT-001, TEST-DRV-001, TEST-UI-001, and TEST-VIC-001; and four lowercase-suffix TEST ids.
The preview deletes only the three TEST-prefixed TR duplicates. It preserves the malformed bracketed TR id, PERF placeholder, architecture-labeled FR, and other noncanonical typed records.
tools/New-RequirementsRecoveryLedger.ps1:585 names create/update/preserve as Classification; it is an operation classification, not the R3-required semantic FR/TR/TEST decision.

failFindings.claim: Placeholder and empty-body invariants are violated.
evidence: The ledger contains five placeholder bodies. [TR-REMOTECTRL-SERVER-001] and PERF-SPRITE-DMA-OPT-001 remain preserve operations and have no Issues entry.
TR-ROMM-SEC-001, TR-VIC20-FLASH-001, TR-VIC20-PIXEL-001, and TR-VIC20-SOUND-001 have proposed empty bodies even though the live Before bodies contain 383, 295, 378, and 239 characters respectively.

The parser at tools/New-RequirementsRecoveryLedger.ps1:163-166 reads only Description for TRs. The current canonical files use freeform body text after metadata, so valid content is erased in the preview.

failFindings.claim: The preview contains non-allowlisted narrowing and acceptance-evidence loss.
evidence: Four TR bodies become empty. TR-VIC20-PIXEL-001 also loses all 3 live acceptance criteria.
TEST-DRV-001 and TEST-UI-001 each lose 3 live acceptance criteria; FR-VIC20-001 drops from 6 criteria to 5.
FR-DRV-002 and FR-DRV-003 bodies shrink by more than half. The preview contains no field-level reason or expected-change allowlist approving these losses.
This violates the R3 requirement to preserve legitimate later fields and to abort on deletion or narrowing.

failFindings.claim: The preview proves mapping presence and type resolution, but not appropriate mapping or per-AC executable coverage.
evidence: Thirteen active FR mapping rows rely solely on domain-mapping-reconstruction: FR-D71-001, FR-D81-001, FR-DEVCARDART-001, FR-DRV1540-001, FR-DRV1541II-001, FR-DRVMODEL-001, FR-DRVMODEL-002, FR-UIFLYOUT-001, FR-UIMENUBAR-001, FR-UIPERIPHERAL-001, FR-VIC20-003, FR-VIC20-004, and FR-VIC20-006.
The fallback evidence emitted at tools/New-RequirementsRecoveryLedger.ps1:731-775 says owner approval required, yet lines 806-826 treat any nonempty typed sets as complete.
No artifact maps each of the 1,026 FR criteria to a specific executable test and VICE source/capture anchor as R3 Phase 3 requires.

failFindings.claim: R3 immutable preflight and oracle proof are incomplete.
evidence: repository-oracle-state.json:113-114 records RomFiles as empty and explicitly defers external ROM hashes until parity execution.
The receipt directory has no pristine-versus-shim trace-equivalence proof, no named machine-profile/media/workload input manifest, and no proof that instrumentation preserves compared behavior.
audit-evidence.json contains TODO and session queries only. Phase 0 cannot be treated as complete before the Phase 2 preview gate.

failFindings.claim: The recovery ledger is record-level, not the decision-complete per-field ledger required by R3.
evidence: tools/New-RequirementsRecoveryLedger.ps1:537-582 selects one authoritative whole record by current, historical, plan, then live precedence; only AC has a separate fallback source.
Ledger entries expose SourceClass plus AC source fields, but no independent provenance/decision/reason for type, title, body, priority, status, each AC, each scope field, or each mapping edge.
Status is copied from live or defaulted pending at lines 569-570; ambiguous completed/closed status is not flagged and unproved live behavior is not systematically reset to pending.

failFindings.claim: The staged preview's invariant engine is not sufficient to authorize owner approval.
evidence: tools/New-RequirementsRecoveryLedger.ps1:916-923 hardcodes DeletesOnlyExpectedWrongTypePlaceholders=true, RetiresLegacyRequirements=false, and ChangesLegacyScope=false instead of deriving all guardrails from operations.
Lines 806-836 check only nonempty mapping sets, typed resolution, and zero FR AC count. They do not block empty bodies, placeholders, malformed ids, semantic misclassification, AC loss, or narrowing.
The generated invariant array therefore reports one blocker while direct operation comparison proves additional blockers.

verdictRationale: DISAGREE. The preview correctly computes its headline counts, preserves legacy FRs, constructs a complete inverse manifest, identifies the server atomicity limitation, and makes the correct no-mutation decision. It is not owner-approvable as the exact R3 recovery set because atomicity is not the only blocker: the preview erases four TR bodies, drops acceptance criteria, preserves unresolved placeholders and malformed classifications, treats provisional domain mappings as complete, lacks per-field provenance/decisions, and has an incomplete immutable oracle preflight. The preview must be regenerated after these defects are corrected. Even after the separately authorized MCP Server atomic capability exists, this unchanged preview must not be applied.

findings.claim: The ledger count claim is exact.
evidence: Independent ConvertFrom-Json/Group-Object found 513 typed records: 232 FR, 141 TR, and 140 TEST.
Among the 232 FRs, the artifact marks 53 IsLegacy and 179 nonlegacy. This finding validates the artifact arithmetic, not the semantic method used to assign legacy scope.

findings.claim: The quantitative FR acceptance-criteria claims are exact.
evidence: Independent enumeration found 232 of 232 FRs with at least one proposed criterion and 1,026 FR criteria total.
Minimum trimmed criterion length is 19; zero criteria are shorter than 15.
A citation-only scan found zero criteria consisting solely of Source/Reference/See/path citations.
Exactly 24 FRs have AcInferred=true and AcSourceClass=inferred-from-surviving-fr-body; each carries the owner-review issue. Semantic suitability is separately failed in C1.

findings.claim: The active-FR mapping existence and typed-resolution arithmetic is exact.
evidence: Independent recomputation over the 179 nonlegacy FRs found zero with an empty TR set and zero with an empty TEST set.
Every proposed TR id resolves to one of the ledger's 141 TR records and every proposed TEST id resolves to one of its 140 TEST records.
The preview contains 232 proposed mapping rows. This finding validates existence and typed resolution only; appropriateness and AC-level coverage are separately failed in C5.

findings.claim: The preview does not delete or scope-shift legacy FRs.
evidence: No operation whose id belongs to the artifact's legacy set is a delete.
Independent before/after comparison found zero FR scope-start or scope-end changes. The only null After scopes are the three expected wrong-type TR deletes.
All artifact-marked legacy records retain proposed scope layer-1 with no end layer.

findings.claim: The operation and inverse-manifest counts are exact.
evidence: There are 442 forward operations: 130 requirement creates (92 FR, 14 TR, 24 TEST), 169 requirement updates (127 FR, 22 TR, 20 TEST), 3 TR deletes, 116 mapping creates, and 24 mapping updates.
The three deletes are exactly TR typed TEST-DRV-001, TEST-UI-001, and TEST-VIC-001.
rollback-manifest.json has 442 inverses, one identity-matching inverse per forward operation, with forward orders 442 through 1 in rollback execution order.

findings.claim: The atomicity blocker is correctly identified and correctly prevents mutation.
evidence: RequirementsController.cs:692-722 exposes separate mixed create and update batch endpoints; lines 748-788 expose independent mapping upsert/delete endpoints.
RequirementsDatabaseDocumentService.cs:752-866 wraps each requirement create or update batch in its own transaction; lines 920-1023 execute mapping upsert/delete independently.
rollback-manifest.json explicitly states FullRollbackProven=false. A correct atomicity diagnosis makes the no-mutation decision accurate even though it does not make the preview content correct.
